using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;

namespace __NAMESPACE__;

public partial class __NOM__
{
    private readonly string _id = $"component-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
    private string TitleId => $"{_id}-title";

    [Parameter, EditorRequired]
    public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;

    [Parameter]
    public RenderFragment? ChildContent { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public string ActionLabel { get; set; } = "Continuer";

    [Parameter]
    public EventCallback OnAction { get; set; }

    [Parameter]
    public bool Disabled { get; set; }

    protected override void OnParametersSet()
    {
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(Title);
        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(ActionLabel);
    }

    private Task InvokeActionAsync() =>
        Disabled || !OnAction.HasDelegate
            ? Task.CompletedTask
            : OnAction.InvokeAsync();
}
